note: The 60 rules of the step-1 topology checklist re-pointed at the metric library: every 'metric' names a report key computed by scripts/toplib.py, tl_features.py or tl_skeleton.py, defined once in definitions.md. 'threshold' is the generic profile; profiles/*.json override thresholds by rule id. scope 'practice' = a claim about good character topology, calibrated on the accepted realistic reference library (a rule a professional reference fails was wrong and was recalibrated); scope 'pipeline' = a requirement of our own build pipeline, only REPORTed on references. 'recalibrated' says what changed from the step-1 checklist and on which reference; calibration.md holds the measured values.

levels.should: a failure blocks the reference grade and needs a reason

rules.title: Manifold and clean
rules.metric: manifold.nonmanifold_edges, manifold.wire_edges, manifold.flipped_edges, manifold.bowtie_verts, quality.zero_area_faces, weld.duplicate, weld.degenerate (D3, D6, D9)

rules.title: No concave quads
rules.recalibrated: step 1: 0 concave quads. The Blender Studio realistic bodies carry 8 (folds at 189-359 deg) and male1591 4 (0.25 %): share <= 0.3 % keeps them and still fails the QuadriFlow control (1.27 %).

rules.title: Quads close to planar
rules.metric: quality.planar_share_over_30 (D9); bodies and heads (hands and parts reported)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: 3 %. Low-poly quads bend more: male1591 7.0 %, proxy741 6.6 %, S12 LOD3 5.9 %; the accepted hold-outs reach 8.5 % (S15) and 9.5 % (female1605). Not discriminating (both controls 7.2-7.6 %): a sanity bound.

rules.title: No long thin quads
rules.metric: quality.aspect.p99 (max reported) (D9); bodies and heads (hands and parts reported)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: p99 7.5 and max 14. S12 LOD2 p99 12.7; single outliers reach 35 (Blender Studio male body), so the maximum is reported, not gated.

rules.title: No sliver corners
rules.metric: quality.min_corner_deg.p1 (min reported) (D9); bodies and heads (hands and parts reported)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: p1 35 deg and min 12 deg. S12 LOD3 p1 21.3; single corners reach 2.3 deg on the Blender Studio male body, so the minimum is reported, not gated.

rules.title: Even spacing
rules.metric: quality.neighbour_area_ratio.p99 (max reported) (D9); bodies and heads (hands and parts reported)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: p99 6, max 11. S12 LOD2 p99 13.7, male1591 13.0, hold-out S15 14.5; single pairs reach 22-76 (Blender Studio female, S15), so the maximum is reported. The Decimate control still fails (p99 16.8).

rules.title: Mirror-exact with a centre loop
rules.recalibrated: pipeline rule (our mirrored modelling and the organic UV step need it). References are symmetric only to about 1e-3 H (Blender Studio bodies 0.99 at 1e-3 H, 0.50 at 1e-4 H; S12 LOD1 needs 1e-2 H): reported on references.

rules.title: Only 3- and 5-edge poles (6+ rare)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: no 6+ pole. Accepted references hold them at hands, feet and face sites: S07 0.94 %, S12 LOD2 0.97 %, male1591 0.88 % of their vertices; S03 1.41 % is its recorded defect (registry intake).

rules.title: Every pole sits in an allowed zone
rules.recalibrated: zones added from the references: shoulder_root / hip_root (the first 35 % of the upper arm / thigh, Blender Studio armpit poles), joint_cap (the extension half of the elbow / knee band: kneecap and elbow-tip poles, consistent with P3), wrist / ankle bands +-25 % (S03 wrist poles at 0.20), neck_stump on head parts (S15).

rules.title: No stray pole in the elbow and knee bands
rules.recalibrated: step 1 counted every pole in the band. The MakeHuman generic proxies and S01 put kneecap / elbow-tip poles on the extension side (1-5 per joint), none on the crease; the crease half (elbow front, knee back) is what pinches, so it alone is gated. The Decimate control keeps 5-7 crease poles per joint.

rules.title: No pole on a pivot ring
rules.recalibrated: step 1 also gated the wrist; every rigged or estimated reference with a hand puts poles on the wrist ring (Blender Studio 2-5, S03 2, S07 2): wrist reported like hip and ankle.

rules.title: No chains of same-type poles
rules.metric: same-valence pole components outside the skip zones (D7, D22)
rules.recalibrated: plane-map heads chain their poles along the plane borders (the Blender Studio planar head read 4 before head_planes was skipped).

rules.title: Limbs are stacks of rings perpendicular to the bone
rules.recalibrated: step 1 measured rings per length (0.8 covered), which reads 0 on a low-poly limb with one face row per segment; now the share of shaft faces on closed ring strips (density-free). proxy741 upper arm 0.56, S03 forearm 0.59; both controls 0.

rules.title: Rings at each hinge
rules.recalibrated: step 1: 2 at the elbow. proxy741 and male1591 bend the elbow on one ring (like most vanilla AoE3 bodies); knees keep 2.

rules.title: Never sparser at the joint than mid-segment
rules.recalibrated: step 1: 1.0. Even ring spacing reads 1.0 +- noise: Blender Studio knees 1.05-1.07, male1591 elbow 1.02.

rules.title: Extra rows on the stretch side
rules.metric: partial rings at a hinge vs the bend direction

rules.title: Shoulder: poles on the armpit side, none on the deltoid top
rules.metric: shoulder band poles (D20, D12); flow.shoulder_<l|r>.arm_root_wrapping reported
rules.recalibrated: step 1 also required 2 straw rings around the arm root. That is one school (hm08 4, S07 2); the Blender Studio bodies carry the neck-concentric rings over the deltoid instead (0-1 wrapping runs). The straw count is reported; the pole placement every reference shares is gated.

rules.title: Hip V-ring and a thigh ring
rules.metric: flow.hip_<l|r> wrapping runs: tilt 20-60 deg near the root; a run at t 0.05-0.20 (D20)
rules.recalibrated: step 1: 1 V-ring and 1 thigh ring. Only hm08 shows a V-ring; proxy741, male1591 and both Blender Studio bodies do not: reported only.

rules.title: Quad parity at ring transitions
rules.metric: ring_parity.odd_without_nonquad (D25, band = faces between the two rings)

rules.title: Neck ring matches the head module
Clean rings around each eye
rules.recalibrated: plane-map heads up to 700 head triangles (Blender Studio planar head 632; S12 LOD2 at 796 already has 2 eye rings).

rules.title: Face poles at the known sites
Region shares inside the reference range
Limb ring sides like the reference
Flat, rigid areas sparser than joints
rules.metric: median face area in declared flat zones / in pivot bands

rules.title: Every loop earns its place
rules.metric: silhouette IoU change per dissolved ring

rules.title: Mitt hands when the skeleton has no finger bones
Grip around the prop bone
rules.metric: prop bone head inside the hand hull

rules.title: Each garment is its own all-quad shell
rules.metric: M1 per garment shell, shared vertices with the base

rules.title: Garment rings at the body's joint rings
rules.metric: joint_rings per covered pivot, garment vs body

rules.title: Weights from the body, same cap
rules.metric: influences per vertex, weight sum error

rules.title: Openings finished
rules.metric: fold-back row per garment boundary loop

rules.title: Fit tested at the extremes
rules.metric: C3 and C6 at every clip extreme

rules.title: Wrap never changes topology
rules.metric: vertex count, edge set, faces, UV vs template

rules.title: Distortion against the template
rules.metric: edge log ratio, area ratio, flipped faces

rules.title: Surface fit is necessary, not sufficient
Reduce by removing loops, not by Decimate
rules.metric: M1 + P1 + P3 on the reduced mesh

rules.title: Silhouette kept
rules.metric: silhouette IoU against the unreduced mesh

rules.title: Triangulate once, at the end, with a fixed method
rules.metric: export copy: faces with more than 3 vertices

rules.title: Diagonals chosen in pose
rules.metric: posed normal deviation of the two diagonals
